rationale: Monotonic volt-var curve designed to mitigate voltage violations. At low voltage (0.92 pu): inject 80% reactive power to raise voltage. At nominal (1.0 pu): neutral response. At high voltage (1.08 pu): absorb 80% reactive power to lower voltage. Curve is strictly monotonic non-increasing in q_fraction as voltage rises. All reactive power commands stay within inverter capability limits. All corrected voltages remain within [0.95, 1.05] pu band.
